pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seeded items are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order.
test/done.test.js 'AC-3' marks 3 and 1 done and checks the order and the ✓ prefix.
test/done.test.js 'AC-4' checks all items in id order, done ones with ✓ and open ones without.
test/done.test.js 'AC-5' checks the exact nav markup for each view and for the default view.
test/done.test.js 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.

test/done.test.js 'AC-7' and the Empty table, Nothing open and Nothing done state tests assert the messages. The spec line was edited late to say 'verified by review: checked by hand', which is not a real step; the test is the evidence. See the high finding about the edit.
traffic/routes.json lists both views. test/done.test.js 'AC-8' asserts them.

findings.what: Commit 644631b ('Follow-up edits') changed AC-7 after the go by appending '— verified by review: checked by hand'. No decision in the spec records an owner call or date for this. 'Checked by hand' is not a followable step. The edit also splits the sentence awkwardly, so the item now reads as partly unverified.
findings.fix: Revert the edit to AC-7. If the owner really wants AC-7 changed, record that as a dated decision. AC-7 is already covered by a test, so no review marker is needed.

findings.what: The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', but commit 644631b edits an acceptance item (AC-7) after the go.
findings.fix: Revert the edit and keep the claim, or disclose the AC-7 change in the PR.

findings.what: The route regex now allows any query string, including a bare '/?'. This is slightly looser than needed and is not asked for in the spec. It is disclosed in the PR and covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.

lenses.note: A spec exists. The code follows both decisions: it opens on open items and uses a query parameter. No extra behaviour was added beyond the traffic-check loosening, which the PR discloses.
All state-table rows have tests. AC-7 was edited in a late commit without an owner decision (high finding).
test/done.test.js names each AC and each state, and its assertions are on behaviour. The tests could not be run here, and CI runs them on every push.
The README describes the views. No stale text found.
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn, so '__proto__' gives 400. The empty-table fallback costs an extra COUNT query; that is correct.
The view value is whitelisted. SQL fragments come from constants. Titles are HTML-escaped.
The change adds a nav and ✓ markers to the page. It is minimal, with no screenshots.
No browser flow was run. The core flow is covered by the Open, Done and All tests.
The 'Changed after the go: nothing' claim is false (see the medium finding). The title is within 72 characters.
